summary.en: Salvadoran troops are now conducting airstrikes and ground assaults against Haitian gang leaders, including an airstrike on Jeff's luxury mansion and the demolition of another stronghold, killing about 20 gang members. Haitian police raids have killed at least 34 suspected gang members, while two Salvadoran soldiers were killed handling explosives during operations. The UN chief condemned a recent attack that killed 47 people, and the EU imposed sanctions on four Haitian gangs for serious human rights violations. The Haitian government formalised a security pact with El Salvador, deploying Salvadoran forces who are fighting gangs in Port-au-Prince. 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Salvadoranske tropper utfører nå luftangrep og bakkestøt mot haitiske gjengledere, inkludert et luftangrep på Jeffs luksusvilla og riving av en annen festning, som drepte omtrent 20 gjengmedlemmer. Haitiske politirazziaer har drept minst 34 mistenkte gjengmedlemmer, mens to salvadoranske soldater ble drept mens de håndterte sprengstoff under operasjoner. FN-sjefen fordømte et nylig angrep som drepte 47 personer, og EU innførte sanksjoner mot fire haitiske gjenger for alvorlige brudd på menneskerettighetene. Den haitiske regjeringen formaliserte en sikkerhetspakt med El Salvador, og deployerte salvadoranske styrker som kjemper mot gjenger i Port-au-Prince. 193 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
